name: Paradise Enrichment Protocol
source:
"If you love something, let it go." 
Or don't. 

Birds of a feather are meant to flock together.

[From [url=https://ceoofbadart.itch.io/paradise-enrichment-protocol]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果你深爱某样事物，就放手任它离去吧。”
或者，绝不放手。

羽翼同类的飞鸟，注定要聚拢相依。

[摘自[url=https://ceoofbadart.itch.io/paradise-enrichment-protocol]itch.io[/url]]
